# Support Guide

Thank you for using Corex Code! Here are the recommended ways to get help and find answers:

## Documentation

Before opening an issue, check the project documentation:
- [README.md](../README.md): Quickstart and CLI usage.
- [v0.1 Specification](../docs/v0.1-spec.md): Technical requirements and roadmap.
- [Safety Model](../docs/safety.md): Trust boundaries, security policy, and approval mechanics.
- [Architecture Guide](../docs/architecture.md): Component lifecycle and execution loop.

## Community & Discussions

- **General Questions**: Ask in [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/lahiruudayakumara/corex-code/discussions).
- **Bug Reports**: Open an issue using our [Bug Report template](https://github.com/lahiruudayakumara/corex-code/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml).
- **Feature Proposals**: Open a discussion or use our [Feature Request template](https://github.com/lahiruudayakumara/corex-code/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml).
- **Security Inquiries**: Follow the private reporting process described in [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).
